players.name: aggressive-max
players.description: Minimax with alpha-beta pruning and memoization, maximizing its own score while assuming the opponent tries to minimize it. Searches as deep as a fixed node budget allows, then estimates.

players.name: aggressive-min
players.description: Minimax with alpha-beta pruning and memoization, minimizing the opponent's score while assuming the opponent maximizes it. It never counts its own points: denying the rival is all it wants.

players.name: cooperative
players.description: Searches for the moves that make the most points in total, for both players, assuming the opponent plays along. Memoized, with the same node budget as the aggressive players.

players.name: easy
players.description: One rule: play on a node that still has a free neighbour, chosen at random among those. On the last move it means scoring the biggest batch of tiles whenever the two remaining nodes are adjacent.

players.name: random
players.description: Places its tiles on a free node chosen uniformly at random. No strategy at all — the baseline every other player has to beat.
